lines.trans: So our mystery Friday caller was sleeping under my attic roof all along.
Sorry for causing you trouble, Chen. Thank you for guarding the bag all week.
Why not go straight to Zhipeng's door and hand him the wooden train?
Three years ago after Grandfather passed away, Zhipeng and I argued bitterly over selling the old house.

lines.trans: Old houses are tied to old memories—arguments like that cut deepest.
Since that day we have not spoken again. Last week I mailed him a postcard.
Asking him to meet you here on Friday at noon?
I only wrote: Friday at noon, something left by Grandfather is waiting for you at Courtyard Inn.
Aha! You feared that if you signed your name, stubborn big brother would stay home!
Chen, you really understand older brothers.
Wait—you were planning to let the clerk hand him the bag and watch from across the street?!
That was Monday's timid plan... before I met all of you.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yuán lái. Marks an 'aha!' discovery ('so it was X all along!').

examples.text: 原来星期五的神秘客人一直睡在我阁楼屋顶下面。
examples.trans: So our mystery Friday caller was sleeping under my attic roof all along.

examples.text: 原来留着爷爷旧物的神秘人一直是你，志豪。
examples.trans: So the mystery person holding Grandfather's keepsake was you all along, Zhihao.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xīng qī wǔ. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 每个星期五 ('every Friday').

examples.text: 我念念：对不起拿错了，请帮我保管到星期五。
examples.trans: Let me read it: Sorry for taking the wrong one; please keep mine until Friday.

examples.text: 到星期五？没写名字，也没签名！
examples.trans: Until Friday? No name written, and no signature either!

meanings.note: Pinyin: de. Links modifiers or owners to nouns (我的书 'my book', 安静的院子 'quiet courtyard').

examples.text: 啊，开了！谢谢。我是小晴，新来的前台。
examples.trans: Oh, it opened! Thank you. I am Qing, the new receptionist.

examples.text: 纸本子？真的吗？
examples.trans: A paper notebook? Really?

meanings.note: Pinyin: shén mì. Describes a mystery guest or locked box.

examples.text: 你看，早餐忙乱和神秘电话你都挺过来了！
examples.trans: Look, you made it through both the breakfast rush and the mystery phone call!

examples.text: 除非他是写成都旅游指南的神秘评审员！
examples.trans: Unless he is a secret inspector writing the Chengdu Travel Guide!

meanings.note: Pinyin: kè rén. Measure word (量词): 位 (wèi), e.g. 一位客人 ('a guest').

examples.text: 跟我当然啦！客气话留给客人吧。
examples.trans: With me, of course! Save the polite talk for the guests.

examples.text: 今天四号房的客人住一整个星期，一定要完美！
examples.trans: Today's guest in room four is staying a whole week; everything must be perfect!

meanings.note: Pinyin: yì zhí. Describes walking straight (一直走) or doing something non-stop.

examples.text: 出大门往左拐，一直走到石桥。
examples.trans: Go out the front gate, turn left, and walk straight to the stone bridge.

examples.text: 志豪先生！您一直站在后面吗？！
examples.trans: Mr Zhihao! Were you standing right there behind us?!

meanings.note: Pinyin: shuì. Everyday verb for sleeping (睡得好 'sleep well').

examples.text: 今晚我应该能睡个好觉了。
examples.trans: Tonight I should be able to sleep well after all.

examples.text: 祝您睡个好觉。早餐七点半在楼下。
examples.trans: Sleep well, sir. Breakfast is at seven thirty downstairs.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zài. As main verb/preposition, gives location (在院子里); before another verb, marks ongoing action ('be doing').

examples.text: 第一天上班，我走得快。电脑在哪里？
examples.trans: On my first day at work, I walk fast. Where is the computer?

examples.text: 在抽屉里。我们这儿用这个大纸本子和铅笔。
examples.trans: In the drawer. Here we use this big paper ledger and a pencil.

meanings.note: Pinyin: wǒ. First-person singular pronoun; add 的 for 'my' (我的) and 们 for 'we/us' (我们).

examples.text: 啊，开了！谢谢。我是小晴，新来的前台。
examples.trans: Oh, it opened! Thank you. I am Qing, the new receptionist.

examples.text: 我叫老陈。你早到了十分钟。
examples.trans: I'm called Chen. You arrived ten minutes early.

meanings.note: Pinyin: gé lóu. Measure word (量词): 间 (jiān), e.g. 一间阁楼 ('an attic room').

examples.text: 那间向阳的旧阁楼书房……快跟我来！
examples.trans: That sunny old attic study... follow me, quickly!

examples.text: 这是三楼阁楼门的小银钥匙。
examples.trans: Here is the small silver key to the third-floor attic door.

meanings.note: Pinyin: wū dǐng. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个屋顶 ('a roof').

examples.text: 听屋顶上的雨声，这儿真温馨！
examples.trans: Listen to the rain on the roof—it feels so cosy up here!

examples.text: 哇……你们看这木头屋顶的比例！
examples.trans: Wow... look at the proportions of this timber roof!

meanings.note: Pinyin: xià mian. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 最下面 ('the bottom part').

examples.text: 快拿到楼下灯光下面看看吧！
examples.trans: Let's bring it downstairs under the light and take a look!

examples.text: 志豪先生早！在木房梁下面睡得好吗？
examples.trans: Morning, Mr Zhihao! Did you sleep well beneath the wooden beams?

meanings.note: Pinyin: gěi. As main verb, 'give'; as preposition/complement, marks the recipient (给你 'for/to you', 递给我 'pass to me').

examples.text: 跟我当然啦！客气话留给客人吧。
examples.trans: With me, of course! Save the polite talk for the guests.

examples.text: 给您四号钥匙。早餐从七点半到十点。
examples.trans: Here is key number four for you. Breakfast is from seven thirty to ten.

meanings.note: Pinyin: nǐ men. Plural 'you' for addressing two or more people (including polite groups).

examples.text: 太谢谢你们两位了。
examples.trans: Thank you both so very much.

examples.text: 不怪你们。只是我身上只有这件外套！
examples.trans: It is not your fault. Still, I only have this one coat on me!

meanings.note: Pinyin: tiān. Used for refilling tea or politely apologizing for causing extra trouble (添麻烦).

examples.text: 给你们添麻烦了，老陈。谢谢这一周帮我看管箱子。
examples.trans: Sorry for causing you trouble, Chen. Thank you for guarding the bag all week.

examples.text: 真不好意思，又给您添麻烦了。
examples.trans: So sorry to have caused you extra trouble again.

meanings.note: Pinyin: má fan. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个麻烦 ('a bother / trouble').

examples.text: 给你们添麻烦了，老陈。谢谢这一周帮我看管箱子。
examples.trans: Sorry for causing you trouble, Chen. Thank you for guarding the bag all week.

examples.text: 这点小事一点也不麻烦，您尽管放心。
examples.trans: Such a small thing is no trouble at all—please rest assured.

meanings.note: Pinyin: le. After a verb, marks completion; at the end of a sentence, signals a change of situation.

examples.text: 早上好！请问，门锁了吗？
examples.trans: Good morning! Excuse me, is the door locked?

examples.text: 啊，开了！谢谢。我是小晴，新来的前台。
examples.trans: Oh, it opened! Thank you. I am Qing, the new receptionist.

meanings.note: Pinyin: lǎo chén. Affectionate respectful name for Courtyard Inn's handyman.

examples.text: 我叫老陈。你早到了十分钟。
examples.trans: I'm called Chen. You arrived ten minutes early.

examples.text: 谢谢老陈。里面的木头小火车看着很珍贵。
examples.trans: Thank you, Chen. The little wooden train inside looked very precious.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xiè xie. Standard expression of gratitude; takes an optional person after it (谢谢您).

examples.text: 啊，开了！谢谢。我是小晴，新来的前台。
examples.trans: Oh, it opened! Thank you. I am Qing, the new receptionist.

examples.text: 谢谢！我们平时都直接叫名字吗？
examples.trans: Thank you! Do we usually just call each other by name here?

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhè. Proximal demonstrative; pairs with a measure word before nouns (这个 'this one', 这间房 'this room').

examples.text: 在抽屉里。我们这儿用这个大纸本子和铅笔。
examples.trans: In the drawer. Here we use this big paper ledger and a pencil.

examples.text: 小美跟这条街上所有人说话都像老朋友。
examples.trans: Mei talks to everyone on this street like old friends.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yī. Changes tone to yí before 4th tone (一个 yí gè) and yì before 1st/2nd/3rd tones (一杯 yì bēi).

examples.text: 第一天上班，我走得快。电脑在哪里？
examples.trans: On my first day at work, I walk fast. Where is the computer?

examples.text: 第一条规矩：先喝热茶，再去开门。
examples.trans: Rule number one: drink hot tea first, then go answer the door.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhōu. Surname of Manager Zhou (周经理); as a noun/classifier, means 'week'.

examples.text: 周经理早！桌子很干净，钥匙也准备好了。

examples.text: 放心吧，周经理。房间干净，毛巾也是新的。
examples.trans: Relax, Manager Zhou. The room is clean, and the towels are fresh.

meanings.note: Pinyin: bāng. Everyday verb for helping someone (帮我一下 'give me a hand').

examples.text: 我来帮您。哎呀，里面装了石头吗？
examples.trans: Let me help you. Goodness, did you pack stones inside?

examples.text: 从这儿往里走。我帮您把蓝色行李箱提上去。
examples.trans: Walk inward from here. I will carry the blue suitcase up for you.

meanings.note: Pinyin: kān guǎn. Note first tone kān when meaning 'watch over / guard'.

examples.text: 给你们添麻烦了，老陈。谢谢这一周帮我看管箱子。
examples.trans: Sorry for causing you trouble, Chen. Thank you for guarding the bag all week.

examples.text: 我们替他看管了一周蓝箱子，他一定愿意帮忙！
examples.trans: After we guarded his blue suitcase all week, he will gladly help!

meanings.note: Pinyin: xiāng zi. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个箱子 ('a suitcase / box').

examples.text: 小晴，快看里面！这不是我的箱子！
examples.trans: Qing, look inside quickly! This is not my case!

examples.text: 告诉他们，我箱子上面口袋里有红丝带！
examples.trans: Tell them there is a red ribbon inside the top pocket of my case!

meanings.note: Pinyin: nín. Respectful singular 'you' used with elders, teachers, and guests (您好！).

examples.text: 在您的外套口袋里吗？
examples.trans: Are they in your coat pocket?

examples.text: 就在您额头上，安全得很。
examples.trans: Right there on your forehead, completely safe.

meanings.note: Pinyin: wèi shén me. Asks for a reason; answered with 因为 ('because').

examples.text: 那个人为什么不拿回自己的箱子就跑了？

examples.text: 为什么把鞋和木头小火车留到星期五呢？
examples.trans: Why leave the shoes and little wooden train here until Friday?

meanings.note: Pinyin: bù. Standard negation for present/future/habitual verbs and adjectives; shifts to bú before a 4th tone (不是 bú shì).

examples.text: 停电的时候，纸还能用。

examples.text: 我要看预订本子，可是找不到我的眼镜了！
examples.trans: I need to read the booking ledger, yet I cannot find my glasses!

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhí jiē. Describes doing something directly without detours.

examples.text: 谢谢！我们平时都直接叫名字吗？

meanings.note: Pinyin: qù. Movement away from the speaker, as main verb (去车站) or directional complement (上去).

examples.text: 第一条规矩：先喝热茶，再去开门。
examples.trans: Rule number one: drink hot tea first, then go answer the door.

examples.text: 晚上九点？等等，我们一起去开大门。
examples.trans: At nine o'clock? Wait, let us open the gate together.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhì péng. Given name of Zhihao's younger brother.

examples.text: 白纸里面包的东西是给我哥哥志鹏的，不是我的。

examples.text: 您为什么不直接去志鹏家门口把木头小火车交给他呢？

meanings.note: Pinyin: jiā. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个家 ('a home').

examples.text: 上面怎么用铅笔整齐画了这条街三家客栈？

examples.text: 看我们这家旁边写着：院子宽度、街道声音、安静九分！

meanings.note: Pinyin: mén kǒu. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 大门口 ('at the doorway').

examples.text: 等等——那星期一晚上门口台阶……第二个蓝箱子……

examples.text: 您为什么不直接去志鹏家门口把木头小火车交给他呢？

meanings.en: measure word for handled objects; disposal marker
meanings.note: Pinyin: bǎ. Counts items with handles or backs (一把钥匙, 一把椅子); as a preposition, fronts a definite object before an action verb.

examples.text: 早上好。没锁，先把把手往上提，再推。

examples.text: 对，八间客房，八把铜钥匙。四号房的客人今天到。
examples.trans: Yes, eight rooms, eight brass keys. Room four's guest arrives today.

meanings.note: Pinyin: mù tou. Measure word (量词): 块 (kuài), e.g. 一块木头 ('a piece of wood').

examples.text: 白纸包着什么？一个木头小火车！
examples.trans: What is wrapped in white paper? A little wooden train!

examples.text: 怪不得这么重，全是木头和皮鞋！
examples.trans: No wonder it was so heavy—all wood and leather shoes!

related.gloss: a piece of wood (measure word 块)

meanings.note: Pinyin: xiǎo. Everyday adjective for small size; also prefixes younger colleagues' names warmly (小晴, 小美).

examples.text: 早上好，姑娘。我有一个宋名下的预订。

examples.text: 是的，宋老师，二楼四号房！坐火车累吗？
examples.trans: Yes, Teacher Song, room four on the second floor! Was the train ride tiring?

examples.text: 白纸包着什么？一个木头小火车！
examples.trans: What is wrapped in white paper? A little wooden train!

meanings.note: Pinyin: jiāo. Often pairs with 给 (交给 'hand over to') or 到 (交到 'deliver to').

examples.text: 交给我吧。我们下楼欢迎他。

examples.text: 您为什么不直接去志鹏家门口把木头小火车交给他呢？

meanings.note: Pinyin: tā. Third-person singular masculine pronoun; pronounced identically to 她 and 它.

examples.text: 他没要回那个装木头小火车的箱子吗？

examples.text: 他留了纸条，请我们保管到星期五。
examples.trans: He left a note asking us to keep it until Friday.

meanings.note: Pinyin: ne. After a noun, asks 'what about X?' (你呢？); at the end of a statement, highlights an ongoing situation.

examples.text: 等一下，咖啡厅的小美正朝我招手呢！

examples.text: 来成都的第一个晚上，怎么能难过呢！
examples.trans: On your very first evening in Chengdu, how could you sit around sad!

meanings.note: Pinyin: sān. Cardinal number 3; combines with measure words (三个) and floors (三楼).

examples.text: 不在，只有我的笔和三张旧收据！

meanings.note: Pinyin: nián. Time classifier taking no 个 directly after numbers (六年 'six years', 今年 'this year').

examples.text: 老橡木，八十年了，一滴水都不漏。

meanings.note: Pinyin: qián. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个前面 ('a front side').

examples.text: 二十五年前我在附近教钢琴，不过记忆淡了。
examples.trans: Twenty-five years ago I taught piano nearby, though memories fade.

examples.text: 没有啊，周经理，南方来的夫妻一小时前住进六号房了。
examples.trans: No, Manager Zhou, the couple from the south checked into room six an hour ago.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yé ye. Measure word (量词): 位 (wèi), e.g. 一位爷爷 ('a grandfather').

examples.text: 我只写了：星期五中午，爷爷留的东西在小院客栈等你。

meanings.note: Pinyin: qù shì. Respectful verb meaning 'die / pass away'.

examples.text: 三年前爷爷去世以后，我和志鹏因为卖老房子大吵了一架。

examples.trans: The old house was left to them before their grandfather passed away.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yǐ hòu. Measure word (量词): 段, e.g. 以后的时间 ('time afterward').

examples.text: 三年前爷爷去世以后，我和志鹏因为卖老房子大吵了一架。

examples.trans: Open it after twelve, boss! Look at the clock: five minutes to twelve!

meanings.note: Pinyin: hé. Joins nouns or pronouns ('A and B'), NEVER two whole clauses; also means 'with' (和你一样).

examples.text: 在抽屉里。我们这儿用这个大纸本子和铅笔。

examples.text: 因为好咖啡和热面包让人开心呀！

meanings.note: Pinyin: mài. Everyday verb for selling goods; fourth tone contrasts with 买 (mǎi 'buy').

examples.text: 三年前爷爷去世以后，我和志鹏因为卖老房子大吵了一架。

meanings.note: Pinyin: lǎo. Describes longtime friends, historic lanes, or warm respect before a colleague's surname (老陈).

examples.trans: So the old house says hello by itself?

examples.text: 老房子每到星期二就松一颗螺丝。坐吧。
examples.trans: Every Tuesday an old house loosens one screw. Sit down.

meanings.note: Pinyin: dà. Everyday adjective for size, age, and strong wind or rain.

examples.text: 在抽屉里。我们这儿用这个大纸本子和铅笔。
examples.trans: In the drawer. Here we use this big paper ledger and a pencil.

examples.text: 两双棕色大男鞋，还有灰色毛衣。
examples.trans: Two pairs of big brown men's shoes, plus grey sweaters.

meanings.note: Pinyin: chǎo. Describes noisy streets or rooms, or arguing aloud.

examples.text: 说真的，我怕一楼吵。我太喜欢这间房了！
examples.trans: Truthfully, I dislike noisy ground-floor rooms. I love this room!

examples.text: 没错。外面大街很吵，进了院子却只听见树叶和小鸟。
examples.trans: Exactly. Outside on the main road it is noisy, yet inside the courtyard you only hear leaves and birds.

架.gloss: measure word for pianos, planes, framed machines

meanings.en: measure word for pianos, planes, framed machines
meanings.note: Pinyin: jià. Counts pianos, airplanes, and framed instruments (一架钢琴 'a piano').

examples.text: 三年前爷爷去世以后，我和志鹏因为卖老房子大吵了一架。
examples.trans: Three years ago after Grandfather passed away, Zhipeng and I argued bitterly over selling the old house.

examples.text: 客厅角落里放着一架老钢琴。
examples.trans: An old piano stands in the corner of the living room.

meanings.note: Pinyin: lián. Pairs with 都/也 to highlight 'even X' (连名字都一样), or means 'connect' as a verb.

examples.text: 老房子连着旧回忆——那种争吵最伤人。
examples.trans: Old houses are tied to old memories—arguments like that cut deepest.

examples.text: 笔挺又干净，周经理！连眼镜都戴在鼻子上，没在额头上。
examples.trans: Crisp and spotless, Manager Zhou! Even your glasses are on your nose instead of your forehead.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhe. Placed right after a verb to show a state or posture continues (门开着 'the door stands open').

examples.text: 就算四号房空着，旧电线也会响两下。
examples.trans: Even when room four is empty, the old wire still rings twice.

examples.text: 白纸包着什么？一个木头小火车！
examples.trans: What is wrapped in white paper? A little wooden train!

meanings.note: Pinyin: jiù. Describes old houses, pipes, or letters—never a person's age (use 老 for people).

examples.text: 就算四号房空着，旧电线也会响两下。
examples.trans: Even when room four is empty, the old wire still rings twice.

examples.text: 不在，只有我的笔和三张旧收据！
examples.trans: Not there—only my pen and three old receipts!

meanings.note: Pinyin: huí yì. Measure word (量词): 段, e.g. 一段回忆 ('a fond memory').

examples.text: 老房子连着旧回忆——那种争吵最伤人。
examples.trans: Old houses are tied to old memories—arguments like that cut deepest.

examples.text: 老钢琴里藏着他们童年最美的回忆。
examples.trans: The old piano holds their fondest childhood memories.

meanings.note: Pinyin: nà. Distal demonstrative before measure words (那个 'that one'); at clause start, means 'then / well then'.

examples.text: 那是什么铃声？有人按了两下！
examples.trans: What was that bell sound? Somebody rang twice!

examples.text: 那里没人。那是四号房的门铃。
examples.trans: Nobody is there. That is the buzzer from room four.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhǒng. Read zhǒng as a measure word for kinds/types (这种, 那种); read zhòng as the verb 'plant/grow'.

examples.text: 老陈，这些香草是你自己种的吗？
examples.trans: Chen, did you grow these herbs yourself?

examples.text: 老房子连着旧回忆——那种争吵最伤人。
examples.trans: Old houses are tied to old memories—arguments like that cut deepest.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhēng chǎo. Measure word (量词): 场 (chǎng), e.g. 一场争吵 ('an argument').

examples.text: 老房子连着旧回忆——那种争吵最伤人。
examples.trans: Old houses are tied to old memories—arguments like that cut deepest.

examples.text: 兄弟俩已经忘了以前的争吵。
examples.trans: The two brothers have already put their old quarrel behind them.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zuì. Superlative adverb placed before adjectives or feeling verbs (最好 'best', 最喜欢 'like best').

examples.text: 只有裙子、乐谱，还有我最喜欢的茶杯！
examples.trans: Only dresses, sheet music, and my favourite teacup!

examples.text: 最上面架子上金色包装那包。怎么了？
examples.trans: The gold-wrapped packet on the top shelf. Why?

meanings.note: Pinyin: shāng. Used for physical injury or emotional hurt (伤人 'hurt someone's feelings').

examples.text: 老房子连着旧回忆——那种争吵最伤人。
examples.trans: Old houses are tied to old memories—arguments like that cut deepest.

examples.text: 别因为小事伤了感情。
examples.trans: Do not hurt feelings over a small matter.

meanings.note: Pinyin: rén. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个人 ('a person').

examples.text: 小美跟这条街上所有人说话都像老朋友。
examples.trans: Mei talks to everyone on this street like old friends.

examples.text: 因为好咖啡和热面包让人开心呀！
examples.trans: Because good coffee and warm bread make people happy!

meanings.note: Pinyin: cóng. Marks a starting point in space or time (从早上到晚上 'from morning to night').

examples.text: 给您四号钥匙。早餐从七点半到十点。
examples.trans: Here is key number four for you. Breakfast is from seven thirty to ten.

examples.text: 从这儿往里走。我帮您把蓝色行李箱提上去。
examples.trans: Walk inward from here. I will carry the blue suitcase up for you.

meanings.note: Pinyin: tiān. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一整天 ('a whole day').

examples.text: 第一天上班，我走得快。电脑在哪里？
examples.trans: On my first day at work, I walk fast. Where is the computer?

examples.text: 第二天上班，干得不错，新手。
examples.trans: For day two on the job, nicely done, rookie.

meanings.note: Pinyin: qǐ. Used for rising or lifting upward (抱起 'pick up in arms').

examples.text: 老陈，抱起那些纸箱，我们下楼吧！
examples.trans: Chen, pick up those cardboard boxes—down the stairs we go!

examples.text: 从那天起我们就再没说过话。上周我给他寄了一张明信片。
examples.trans: Since that day we have not spoken again. Last week I mailed him a postcard.

meanings.note: Pinyin: wǒ men. First-person plural pronoun; add 的 for 'our' (我们的).

examples.text: 在抽屉里。我们这儿用这个大纸本子和铅笔。
examples.trans: In the drawer. Here we use this big paper ledger and a pencil.

examples.text: 谢谢！我们平时都直接叫名字吗？
examples.trans: Thank you! Do we usually just call each other by name here?

meanings.note: Pinyin: jiù. Highlights immediacy, exact location (就在这里), or smooth consequence ('then').

examples.text: 就在您额头上，安全得很。
examples.trans: Right there on your forehead, completely safe.

examples.text: 朝院子，就在老树上面，非常安静。
examples.trans: Toward the courtyard, right above the old tree; it is very quiet.

examples.text: 自从修好了密封条，这扇木窗就再没漏过风。
examples.trans: Ever since the weatherstripping was fixed, this wooden window has never let in a draft again.

examples.text: 那位神秘的客人留下一封感谢信后，就再没出现过。
examples.trans: After leaving a thank-you letter behind, that mysterious guest never appeared again.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shuō. Most common verb of speaking.

examples.text: 谁也别说出去！门铃响的时候要微笑。
examples.trans: Do not tell anyone! Smile warmly when the bell rings.

examples.text: 我还没喝早咖啡呢，千万别说急事！
examples.trans: I have not had my morning coffee yet; please do not say emergency!

meanings.note: Pinyin: guò. Read neutral-tone guo after a verb for 'have ever done' (见过); read guò as a verb meaning 'cross/pass' (过河 'cross the river').

examples.text: 早跟你说过，那个平板是个坑。
examples.trans: Told you before, that tablet is a trap.

examples.text: 出门左拐，直走到桥。要过河吗？
examples.trans: Left out the gate, straight to the bridge. Do I cross the river?

meanings.note: Pinyin: huà. Measure word (量词): 句 (jù), e.g. 一句话 ('a sentence / remark').

examples.text: 跟我当然啦！客气话留给客人吧。
examples.trans: With me, of course! Save the polite talk for the guests.

examples.text: 我修水管和椅子。人的话得自己修。
examples.trans: I fix water pipes and chairs. People have to fix their own words.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shàng. Used both as a directional verb/complement ('up, onto') and location word ('on top of').

examples.text: 早上好。没锁，先把把手往上提，再推。
examples.trans: Good morning. Not locked; lift the handle up first, then push.

examples.text: 就在您额头上，安全得很。
examples.trans: Right there on your forehead, completely safe.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jì. Used for mailing letters, postcards, or parcels.

examples.text: 从那天起我们就再没说过话。上周我给他寄了一张明信片。
examples.trans: Since that day we have not spoken again. Last week I mailed him a postcard.

examples.text: 房东律师寄来的？奇怪——我们房租一直交到明年夏天了。
examples.trans: Sent by the landlord's lawyer? Strange—our rent is paid right through next summer.

张.gloss: measure word for flat surfaces and paper

meanings.en: measure word for flat surfaces and paper
meanings.note: Pinyin: zhāng. Counts tables, beds, paper sheets, tickets, receipts, and luggage tags (一张桌子, 一张纸).

examples.text: 不在，只有我的笔和三张旧收据！
examples.trans: Not there—only my pen and three old receipts!

examples.text: 旁边的把手上系着一张小纸牌。
examples.trans: There is a small paper card tied on the side handle.

meanings.note: Pinyin: míng xìn piàn. Measure word (量词): 张 (zhāng), e.g. 一张明信片 ('a postcard').

examples.text: 从那天起我们就再没说过话。上周我给他寄了一张明信片。
examples.trans: Since that day we have not spoken again. Last week I mailed him a postcard.

examples.text: 看，已经十二点零四分了。也许他把明信片扔进垃圾桶了。
examples.trans: Look, it is twelve-oh-four already. Maybe he tossed the postcard into the bin.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yuē. Used for arranging a meeting time or meal.

examples.text: 约他星期五中午在这儿见面吗？
examples.trans: Asking him to meet you here on Friday at noon?

examples.text: 我约了老朋友明天中午喝茶。
examples.trans: I arranged to meet an old friend for tea tomorrow at noon.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhōng wǔ. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个中午 ('a noon hour').

examples.trans: Sir? He says: Please do not open the white paper parcel; I will come Friday at noon.

examples.trans: When the suitcase owner walks in Friday at noon, I am sitting in the front row!

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhèr. Spoken variant of 这里 ('here').

examples.text: 在抽屉里。我们这儿用这个大纸本子和铅笔。
examples.trans: In the drawer. Here we use this big paper ledger and a pencil.

examples.text: 没错！你已经很习惯这儿了。
examples.trans: Exactly! You already fit right in here.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jiàn miàn. Separable verb-object compound (跟朋友见面 'meet a friend').

examples.text: 约他星期五中午在这儿见面吗？
examples.trans: Asking him to meet you here on Friday at noon?

examples.text: 好久不见，真高兴今天能在成都见面！
examples.trans: Long time no see—how wonderful to meet in person in Chengdu today!

meanings.note: Pinyin: xiě. Used for writing characters, notes, letters, or reviews.

examples.text: 只剩三十五分钟了！他肯定会写一星差评！
examples.trans: Only thirty-five minutes left! He will surely write a one-star bad review!

meanings.note: Pinyin: liú. Used for leaving a note/keepsake, saving food, or staying on (留下来).

examples.text: 跟我当然啦！客气话留给客人吧。
examples.trans: With me, of course! Save the polite talk for the guests.

examples.text: 为什么把鞋和木头小火车留到星期五呢？

meanings.note: Pinyin: dōng xi. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个东西 ('a thing / item').

examples.trans: What is wrapped inside that white paper is for my brother Zhipeng, not mine.

examples.trans: Courtyard Inn, good morning! This is Qing speaking.

meanings.note: Pinyin: děng. Everyday verb for waiting (等一下 'wait a moment').

examples.trans: Hello! You must be Qing, right? I am Mei from the kitchen.

meanings.note: Pinyin: pà. Expresses fear, worry, or sensitivity to noise/cold (怕吵 'dislike noise').

examples.text: 哈！你怕签了名字，倔脾气大哥就不出门了！

meanings.note: Pinyin: qiān. Used for signing names, contracts, or delivery slips.

examples.text: 哈！你怕签了名字，倔脾气大哥就不出门了！
examples.trans: Aha! You feared that if you signed your name, stubborn big brother would stay home!

examples.text: 请在这份收据下面签上名字。

meanings.note: Pinyin: míng zi. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个名字 ('a name').

examples.trans: Thank you! Do we usually just call each other by name here?

examples.trans: Is there a name or a phone number on it?

examples.text: 老木匠手艺好，脾气也特别温和。

meanings.note: Pinyin: dà gē. Measure word (量词): 位 (wèi), e.g. 一位大哥 ('an older brother').

examples.text: 哈！你怕签了名字，倔脾气大哥就不出门了！
examples.trans: Aha! You feared that if you signed your name, stubborn big brother would stay home!

examples.text: 而且大哥想装作镇定的时候，绝对不会早到。

meanings.en: go out the door; head out
meanings.note: Pinyin: chū mén. Separable verb-object compound for leaving home or the inn.

examples.text: 你们守着，我出门啦！
examples.trans: Hold the fort—I am heading out the door!

examples.text: 出门左拐，直走到桥。要过河吗？
examples.trans: Left out the gate, straight to the bridge. Do I cross the river?

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhēn. Exclamatory adverb before adjectives (真好！ 'How nice!') or adjective 'genuine'.

examples.trans: How strange! We rode the very same morning train to the same district.

meanings.note: Pinyin: dǒng. Means 'understand' (听懂 'understand by listening').

meanings.note: Pinyin: dāng. Means 'act in the role of' (当哥哥 'be an older brother', 当前台主管 'serve as front-desk manager').

examples.text: 老陈，你真懂当哥哥的人。

examples.text: 别抢人，小美！小晴，你愿意留下来当正式前台主管吗？

meanings.note: Pinyin: gē ge. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个哥哥 ('an older brother').

examples.text: 那里住着一位老木匠和两个孙子——哥哥弹钢琴，弟弟最爱小火车！

examples.text: 哥哥性格爽朗声音大，弹音阶总是急匆匆的。

meanings.note: Pinyin: děng deng. Urgent or casual reduplication of 等 ('wait!').

examples.text: 等等，深蓝色的，跟您的一样啊！

examples.trans: Wait—that street is right nearby, only five minutes on foot!

examples.text: 电线本来就该拉直了。正常保养，别多想。

meanings.note: Pinyin: dǎ suàn. Works as both verb ('plan to do') and noun ('a plan').

examples.text: 等等——您本来打算让店员把箱子交给他，自己躲在街对面看？！

examples.trans: Why did that person run off without taking his own suitcase back?

meanings.note: Pinyin: duǒ. Used for ducking out of rain or hiding away.

examples.text: 等等——您本来打算让店员把箱子交给他，自己躲在街对面看？！
examples.trans: Wait—you were planning to let the clerk hand him the bag and watch from across the street?!

examples.text: 当然来了。为什么躲在神秘纸条后面？
examples.trans: Of course I came. Why hide behind a mystery note?

meanings.note: Pinyin: jiē. Measure word (量词): 条 (tiáo), e.g. 一条街 ('a street').

examples.text: 可惜没有电话号码，只有两个字母和老街名字。
examples.trans: Unfortunately there is no phone number, only two letters and an old street name.

examples.text: 等等，这条街就在附近，走过去只要五分钟！
examples.trans: Wait—that street is right nearby, only five minutes on foot!

meanings.note: Pinyin: duì miàn. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 街对面 ('across the street').

examples.text: 等等——您本来打算让店员把箱子交给他，自己躲在街对面看？！
examples.trans: Wait—you were planning to let the clerk hand him the bag and watch from across the street?!

examples.text: 客栈正对面是一家安静的花店。
examples.trans: Directly across from the inn is a quiet flower shop.

meanings.note: Pinyin: kàn. Covers looking at something, reading silently, or visiting someone; add 见/到 for 'catch sight of'.

examples.text: 我要看预订本子，可是找不到我的眼镜了！
examples.trans: I need to read the booking ledger, yet I cannot find my glasses!

examples.text: 老板，看一下桌子后面的镜子。
examples.trans: Boss, take a look in the mirror behind the desk.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shì. Links two nouns (我是小晴); do NOT use simple 是 before plain adjectives like 好 or 忙.

examples.text: 啊，开了！谢谢。我是小晴，新来的前台。
examples.trans: Oh, it opened! Thank you. I am Qing, the new receptionist.

examples.text: 有道理！这些是钥匙吗？
examples.trans: Fair enough! Are these the keys?

meanings.note: Pinyin: xīng qī yī. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 上星期一 ('last Monday').

examples.text: 呀，这就是星期一火车上那只双胞胎箱子吗？
examples.trans: Oh, is this that twin suitcase from Monday's train?

examples.text: 您尽管看，宋老师。星期一下午大堂暗。
examples.trans: Go right ahead, Teacher Song. Monday afternoon the lobby was dim.

meanings.note: Pinyin: dán xiǎo. Literally 'gallbladder small'.

examples.text: 那是星期一胆小的计划……那时候还没认识你们。
examples.trans: That was Monday's timid plan... before I met all of you.

examples.text: 别看那只小猫胆小，跟熟人可亲了。
examples.trans: That kitten may be shy at first, yet warms right up to familiar faces.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jì huà. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个计划 ('a plan').

examples.text: 那是星期一胆小的计划……那时候还没认识你们。
examples.trans: That was Monday's timid plan... before I met all of you.

examples.text: 周末开院子咖啡馆的计划大家都赞成。
examples.trans: Everyone is in favor of the plan to open the courtyard café.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shí hou. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 这个时候 ('this moment').

examples.text: 停电的时候，纸还能用。
examples.trans: Paper still works when the power goes out.

examples.text: 谁也别说出去！门铃响的时候要微笑。
examples.trans: Do not tell anyone! Smile warmly when the bell rings.

meanings.note: Pinyin: hái. Everyday adverb meaning 'still' (还在), 'not yet' (还没), or 'even more' after 比.

examples.text: 还没有吗？请记下我们客栈的电话和地址，谢谢！
examples.trans: Not yet? Please write down our inn's phone number and address, thank you!

examples.text: 宋老师，真对不起，那边还没有消息。
examples.trans: Teacher Song, I am truly sorry; they have no news over there yet.

meanings.note: Pinyin: méi. Short form of 没有; negates 有 and past/completed actions (没锁 'isn't locked / didn't lock').

examples.text: 早上好。没锁，先把把手往上提，再推。
examples.trans: Good morning. Not locked; lift the handle up first, then push.

examples.text: 那里没人。那是四号房的门铃。
examples.trans: Nobody is there. That is the buzzer from room four.

meanings.note: Pinyin: rèn shi. Contrast 知道 ('know a fact').

examples.text: 你好，小美，很高兴认识你！好香啊！
examples.trans: Hello, Mei, nice to meet you! Something smells wonderful!

examples.text: 真的吗？您在成都认识什么人吗？
examples.trans: Really? Do you know someone here in Chengdu?

meanings.note: Pinyin: huí tóu. Appears in the friendly farewell 回头见！ ('See you soon!').

examples.text: 我先去送热茶，我们回头聊！
examples.trans: Let me deliver this hot tea first—we will talk soon!

examples.text: 今天辛苦了，回头见！
examples.trans: Great work today—see you soon!

meanings.note: Pinyin: jiàn. Appears in farewells (再见, 明天见) and as result complement of perception (看见, 听见).

examples.text: 晚安，小晴。明天早餐见。
examples.trans: Good night, Qing. See you at breakfast tomorrow.

examples.text: 老陈，听得见吗？我刚经过绿药店！
examples.trans: Chen, can you hear me? I just passed the green pharmacy!
